other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: No single account-opening minimum was found. Homepage says you can invest in any real stock from 10 USD. That is a per-stock minimum, not an account minimum. Client agreement sets a minimum withdrawal of 50 EUR when freely available funds are at least 50 EUR.

other_fees.label: Minimum withdrawal
other_fees.note: Client agreement, March 2026: clients with freely available funds of at least 50 EUR may request a withdrawal of at least 50 EUR. Other currencies must be at least the EUR 50 equivalent.
